title: Follow-Up Arrow
description: Fires additional arrows after main shot
body:
![Follow-Up Arrow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25db729eb330bcb1907c125e2377bdc606a24ed6.jpeg) # Follow-Up Arrow > The follow-up your bow never had. Follow-Up is a bow enchantment that fires additional arrows immediately after your main shot, each with a short delay. --- ## Enchantment Levels | Level | Extra Arrows | Description | |---|---|---| | Follow-Up I | +1 arrow | One follow-up arrow fires after the main shot. | | Follow-Up II | +2 arrows | Two follow-up arrows fire in quick succession. | Follow-up arrows deal full damage and carry over applicable enchantments at reduced effect (e.g. Flame at half duration). Each arrow fires with a brief rhythmic delay — just enough to feel satisfying. > **Note:** Follow-up arrows reset the target's invulnerability timer so every shot connects — no phantom hits. --- ## How to Obtain ### Loot Chests Found naturally in dungeon and structure loot with a chance roll. ### Fletcher Villager - **Expert (level 4)** — sells Follow-Up I - **Master (level 5)** — sells Follow-Up II --- ## Configuration Tweak Follow-Up to fit your playstyle via the config file, or in-game with the [Configured](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/configured) mod. | Setting | Default | Description | |---|---|---| | Consume Arrows | ✅ On | Follow-up arrows consume from your inventory. Turn off for unlimited follow-ups regardless of ammo. | | Damage Multiplier | `1.0` | Damage dealt by each follow-up arrow. `1.0` = full damage, `0.5` = half damage. | > **Infinity:** A single regular arrow covers all follow-up shots when Infinity is active. Tipped and special arrows always consume from inventory, consistent with vanilla behavior. ---
